title: German Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and comforting German-inspired lentil stew, perfect for a cold winter's day. Made with a variety of vegetables and spices, this stew is a true delight.

ingredients.name: velvety stew meat
ingredients.notes: Optional, can be omitted for vegetarian version

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion, carrot, and celery, and sauté until the vegetables are tender.
Add garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add lentils, stew meat (if using), and tomato paste (if using). Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30-40 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley (if desired).
